I-129-H1B.label: Form I-129 (H-1B Transfer)
I-129-H1B.notes: Work authorization begins on receipt notice filing date

I-539-H4.label: Form I-539 (H-4 COS)
I-539-H4.notes: No work authorization while pending unless EAD separately approved

I-539-B2.label: Form I-539 (B-1/B-2 COS)
I-539-B2.notes: Unpredictable; may be granted fewer than 6 months

I-539-F1.label: Form I-539 (F-1 COS)
I-539-F1.notes: Must file within grace period; status maintained while pending

I-129-O1.label: Form I-129 (O-1 Visa)
I-129-O1.notes: Requires extensive documentation of extraordinary ability

depart-us.label: Voluntary Departure
depart-us.notes: No USCIS processing needed. Depart before grace period ends.
